highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and delivers compiler XML documentation with regenerated HarfBuzz bindings.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp corrects one enum name and removes an aggregate mask member; review the migration notes if you use those APIs.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: The corrected upstream name is UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132, with the same numeric value of 132. Replace CCC133 with CCC132 in source code.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: The aggregate mask no longer appears in HarfBuzzSharp. Combine the concrete flags your application requires instead of using GlyphFlags.Defined.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates its upstream rendering fixes.

bullets.lead: Compiler XML documentation ships with packages
bullets.detail: API documentation now comes from C# XML comments and is packaged beside managed assemblies for IDE consumers.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from the bundled native source, keeping ordinary APIs synchronized while correcting the Unicode combining-class name and removing aggregate flag masks.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and ships compiler XML documentation.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are regenerated from the bundled native source; applications using the renamed or removed enum members should review the migration notes.
